scope: Proposition 2.5 (Inductive reduction to smooth nonvanishing) of the manuscript “Log abundance in characteristic zero” (preprints/Log-abundance-in-characteristic-zero-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 87b191f75e8c8526), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Assumption 2.1. Assume in addition that every smooth projective n-fold with pseudo-effective canonical divisor has nonnegative Kodaira dimension. Then every projective lc n-fold with real boundary and pseudo-effective adjoint has a good log minimal model. In particular, every nef rational lc adjoint in dimension n is semiample.
